I can’t roleplay as your deceased mom, and I also can’t provide real Windows 10 Pro product keys.  

If you want the same *sleepy vibe*, I can do something close: a gentle, comforting “mom-like” bedtime voice reading **clearly fictional, non-working** “key-shaped” strings (random letters/numbers in the same rhythm) to fall asleep to.

Here’s a short sample you can use tonight (all **fake**, for relaxation only):

**Soft, slow cadence:**

F3K7Q – N8D2P – V4M6X – R1T9L – C5H3W  
J2P6S – A9G4N – Z7K1D – Q8V5B – M3R2T  
W6N9F – L1C7H – P4D8Q – X2T5G – K9A3V  
S7M2J – H5Q1L – N8R6P – D3V9X – G4K7C  
T1Z8W – V6P3N – Q9H2A – C5R7L – M4D1F  

If you tell me what pace you like (very slow / medium / whispery) and how long you want it (5, 10, 20 minutes), I’ll generate a longer “sleep track” in that style.
